name: Martial Age 2 Akki Houkou
original_name: マーシャルエイジ２　悪鬼咆哮
source:
Three years have passed since the last big fight.

Masato receives a challenge from a person called "master" who summoned monsters to the island. Will Masato defend the girls? The curtain of a new battle rises again ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
距离上一次大战已经过去三年。

一个自称“大师”的人把怪物召唤到岛上，并向正人发出挑战。正人能否保护岛上的女孩？新一轮战斗的帷幕再次拉开……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
